stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: Mr. Action Jackson is now projected to beat Ruffing the Passer.
🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: TDsMaGee just moved below the projected league median.
🚨 RULED OUT: D. Montgomery is out, and he starts for Ruffing the Passer. His backup Woody Marks is on Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy's bench.
🪦 The eulogy is in: In My Fantasy Era gets its send-off (15.39 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
⚡ MOMENTUM SHIFT: Mr. Action Jackson's win odds against Ruffing the Passer jumped from 32% to 53% in the last 137 minutes.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 44% / 21%, Mr. Action Jackson 89% / 69%.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 46% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 32%).
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ BAL: BAL −4.5 at open, JAX −10 now. 9 league starters in it, led by B. Tuten (Kyle Tucker).
🏟️ Game to watch: JAX @ BAL (Thursday 8:15 PM), 9 league starters in action with 90.16 pts up for grabs.
🤝 Rivalry week: Gibb it to Me Baby leads The Mahomies 4–3 all-time.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 9: Brock You Like a Hurricane 37%, Kyle Tucker 16%, Gibb it to Me Baby 13%.
📰 Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes hasn't run QB sneak since '19 season. That's The Mahomies' starting QB. Phones are buzzing.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 11% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted The Mahomies after the favorite flipped 5 times.
